title: Charlie Munger: The Psychology of Human Misjudgment [Outliers]
summary: In his legendary talk The Psychology of Human Misjudgement, Munger outlined 25 psychological tendencies that quietly distort how we think. From incentives and social proof to denial, envy, and authority bias, you’ll learn how these hidden tendencies shape behavior and how to build the mental defenses that helped Munger create one of the best decision records in history. You’ll hear practical examples, powerful antidotes, and lessons you can apply to business, investing, and everyday life.
